open_ended_qa.gold_answer: WHO provides the example of consumption of raw camel milk as a primary way MERS-CoV can be transmitted through animal products. Additionally, WHO warns against drinking camel urine and eating improperly cooked meat as other potential transmission routes.

open_ended_qa.question: What is the characterization of MERS-CoV transmission source from dromedary camels to humans?
open_ended_qa.gold_answer: MERS-CoV transmission from dromedary camels to humans occurs through direct or indirect contact with dromedaries, which serve as the natural host and zoonotic source of MERS-CoV infection. This transmission can also involve contact with dromedary camel animal products, such as consumption of raw camel milk.
